create_get_lock: create a file lock for a model name or path with an optional cache directory to prevent concurrent access
build_filter_duplicate_safetensors_files: build a filter that removes duplicate safetensors files using the model index to keep only valid weight files
test_validate_safetensors_file: test a safetensors file for corruption and return true if readable or false if invalid
refactor_default_weight_loader: refactor the default weight loader to copy loaded tensors into parameter data with scalar broadcast support
summarize_compute_weights_checksum: summarize a set of named model weight tensors into a SHA-256 checksum string for verification
